concerns: In InboxService, when a Conversation is created, a placeholder lead username 'lead_' + leadId is used. It would be safer to check the Lead table/repository first to retrieve the actual username if available.

No higher-level service is implemented to coordinate the data layer (the work is limited to TgAccountRepository/ProxyRepository and a database migration). While correct for the Data role, future work will need to integrate these models into services/controllers.

LeadImportService uses a basic custom CSV split logic (line.split(',', -1)). This does not support complex CSVs containing escaped commas inside quotes and could cause runtime issues with more complicated metadata payloads.
Statuses such as warm-up status and cycle status are stored as raw Strings instead of Enums, reducing type-safety and potentially leading to typos in status checks in future modules.

The validation script design/validate_openapi.py is a great addition, but it runs as a standalone Python script. Integrating this contract validation into the standard Maven build lifecycle or a CI workflow would prevent regression more effectively.
